svg.title: Moving data can cost more than computing on it
svg.desc: A chip cross-section: a matrix engine and scratchpad SRAM on the accelerator die, HBM stacks off-die. Data pipes between them grow wider with distance, showing that moving bytes costs more than computing on them.
svg.text: Pipe width = time and energy per byte. Fusion and tiling exist to keep
intermediates out of the widest pipe entirely
